actual: Changing Cancel notice 24 → 48 and clicking Save does NOT persist. Tried four times with different input methods (paste-fill, replace-fill, key-by-key typing, ArrowUp increments to 48) — each time the field showed 48 and the note switched to '41 enrolled families keep their current rule where it is more generous. Families who enroll from now on get the new rule.', but no toast or confirmation ever appeared, the Cancel/Save buttons stayed enabled, and every reload showed Cancel notice 24 again with the default note. The setting remains at the agreed default of 24 hours, unaltered. Step 1 passes (defaults match exactly); step 3 (Maya's cancel dialog) was not attempted — it needs Maya.
expected: Changing Cancel notice from 24 to 48 hours and saving persists the new notice (families enrolling from now on get 48 hours).
steps: Open the facility settings Makeups tab and read the card.
Change notice from 24 to 48 hours and save.
title: PRG-018: Makeups Cancel notice change (24 → 48 hours) does not persist — Save appears to do nothing
